name: Pick a seat, human or all-AI table
looks: A row of seats fills in: a human avatar first, then two model chips, with a panel on the right for pasting a custom API key and endpoint. A bold action button sits beneath, ready to start.
build: The seats pop in left to right on a short stagger, each a rounded avatar chip; the custom-API panel's fields reveal with a quick fade/slide, and its 'connect' button gets a subtle glow once a value is present.
sound: A soft pop per seat filling, a lighter tick on the API panel's fields.
prompt: Show the viewer they can take a seat at their own product: fill a row of seats with a human avatar and a couple of AI options, plus a panel to plug in a custom key or endpoint, ending on one clear button to start.
